description_en: Modifies the basic information about a network domain
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost modify-network-domain --instance-id bastionhost-cn-x0r3hyr3f09 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --network-domain-id 3 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyNetworkDomain

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host to which the network domain to modify belongs.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:
要修改的网络域所在堡垒机的实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host to which the network domain to modify belongs.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要修改的网络域所在堡垒机的区域ID。
Region ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the network domain to modify
parameters.name: network_domain_id

parameters.help_en: The new name of the network domain
parameters.help_zh: 指定修改后的网络域名称
parameters.name: network_domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The new connection mode of the network domain. Valid values:

Direct

Proxy
parameters.help_zh:
指定修改后的网络域类型。取值：

Direct：直连
Proxy：代理
parameters.name: network_domain_type

parameters.help_en: The new remarks of the network domain
parameters.help_zh: 修改后的网络域备注信息
parameters.name: comment

fields.help_en: The new IP address of the proxy server
fields.help_zh: 修改后的代理服务器地址
fields.name: address

fields.help_en:
The node type of the proxy server to modify. Valid values:

Master: primary proxy server.

Slave: secondary proxy server
fields.help_zh:
要修改的代理服务器节点。取值：

Master：主代理服务器
Slave：备代理服务器
fields.name: node_type

fields.help_en: The new password of the proxy server account
fields.help_zh: 修改后的代理服务器账户的密码
fields.name: password

fields.help_en: The new port of the proxy server
fields.help_zh: 修改后的代理服务器端口
fields.name: port

fields.help_en:
The new proxy mode. Valid values:

SSHProxy

HTTPProxy

Socks5Proxy
fields.help_zh:
修改后的代理方式。取值：

SSHProxy：SSH代理
HTTPProxy：HTTP代理
Socks5Proxy：Socks代理
fields.name: proxy_type

fields.help_en: The new username of the proxy server account
fields.help_zh: 修改后的代理服务器的账户名
fields.name: user

parameters.help_en: The information about the proxy servers in the network domain
parameters.help_zh: 网络域中的代理服务器信息
parameters.name: proxies

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
